failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines over the next two weeks, even if PARKS mobility continues to increase by more than 5 points week-on-week.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve over the next 28 days, despite RESIDENTIAL mobility continuing to fall and TRANSIT mobility continuing to rise.

failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL mobility continues to fall, but RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: The strong and accelerating growth in PARKS mobility suggests a general increase in outdoor activity and willingness to leave home. If RETAIL_REC also shows any positive momentum (week-on-week increase), this combined activity will drive further RETAIL_REC growth over the next four weeks.
